title: Same Tree
tip: Null handling. Don't crash on empty trees.
statement:
Given the roots of two binary trees `p` and `q`, write a function to check if they are the same (identical structure and values).

Trees are given as level-order arrays (`null` for missing children).
constraints: The number of nodes is in [0, 10^4].
editorial: Compare vals, then both lefts and both rights. Null mismatches fail.
